translations.web: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.
translations.bsb: They advance as through a wide breach; through the ruins they keep rolling in.
translations.kjv: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled
translations.asv: As through a wide breach they come: In the midst of the ruin they roll themselves upon me.
